name: Reverse Box Turn (backward half)
notes: Owner's description (2026-11-16): the Box Turn with everything reversed. Follows Reverse Box Turn (forward half); the lead starts back on the right foot, side on the left, close the right, turning a quarter to the left. The mirror image of Box Turn (backward half), with the same sizes (0.5 back, then the left foot lands 0.4 beyond the right in the turned frame, measured from the facing before the turn as 0.9 back and 0.2 right), the whole quarter turn on count 2, the feet closing on 3 and no rise. Called the Left Box Turn in the American syllabus.
